warning_texts: release/report.md line 3 states the population as all orders inside the period while the spec, the registries and the claim caveats say delivered orders only; the header line and the report's free text are covered by no deterministic rule in check_plan.json, so both release gates passing is silence

check_plan.json lists claims_rendered and caveats_rendered under accepted_unproven (prove-plan could not find the claim register), so the only two rules gate_release_document applies were never shown to fire on a broken release.

gate_release_machine records its comparisons in release_surface_gate.json rather than evidence/checks.json, and gate_release_document's checks.json has no recompute_*, claims_recomputed, component_sum or column_identity entry, so none of this stage's numeric recomputes has a machine comparison to cr

release/dashboard_data.json has a period but no population field, so a dashboard reader gets the population only through each card's caveats.

summary: All 21 rendered numbers across report.md, dashboard_data.json and the manifest recompute from calculated_metrics.json and display exactly (country sum 35741.52 = headline, 27/57 = 0.473684, 40235.02 - 4493.50 = 35741.52), and every claim caveat is visible outside HTML comments; but report.md line 3 tells the reader the population is all orders inside the period, contradicting the spec population (delivered orders inside the period) that governs every figure on the page, and no release gate rule reads that line.
